File Information
Collection: Kitchen Margin Tracker API
Environment: Kitchen Margin Tracker - Local
Collection Description
All REST endpoints of the Kitchen Margin Tracker backend (Express + MongoDB + Groq/Gemini AI). **How to run:** import this collection and the `Kitchen Margin Tracker - Local` environment, start the backend (`npm run dev` in backend/), select the environment and run the whole collection in the Collection Runner. Each run registers a fresh owner (via `runId`), saves the JWT automatically, adds a manager, checks every role rule and the margin maths, asks the AI assistant, then cleans up. Every request has tests and a saved example response.
